about: Shadow-mark matrix (hub_shadow_check/mark_matrix.gd): every player kind and enemy type, every idle/walk/attack frame on disk; per foot, grounded attaches within 1 cell of its mark pin, raised shows a gap matching its lift; mark mask has no detached chunk or enclosed hole at the cell scale. Planted offset pin, glued raised foot and stray chunk must each FAIL. Contact sheet and rows: _logs/mark-matrix/. Flyers (fly_matrix.gd): every fly enemy x 8 facings x 3 altitudes detached, under the body, size/darkness falling with altitude, no stale mark in an erratic run; planted glued and hang must FAIL; FLY_BENCH line (20 bats, usec per frame old vs new); frame 'flyers' stages each flyer at 3 altitudes for the contact sheet.
